metadata.name: Nigel Farage
metadata.description: British political leader advocating national sovereignty, substantially lower immigration, tax reductions and changes to public service delivery.
metadata.scope: Current documented governing or campaigning position through 4 October 2026. Recent conduct is prioritised; earlier material is used only as a stated continuity-based inference. Party proposals are attributed as the leader’s endorsed programme, not implemented law. Every answer is an interpretive assessment, with lower confidence for biomedical hypotheticals and fine-grained psychological causation. No scores were targeted.
